name: Siren Song
source: Charlotte, a very precocious young woman, is forced to join her estranged father, Bobby (names can be changed in-game) on his summer tour after her mom leaves for work overseas. What starts as reluctant family obligation becomes something neither of them expected—a connection that challenges everything they thought they knew about each other, love, family, and the rules society expects them to follow.
